Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the next step with us. Attached is a short project spec that should take ~3–6 hours. Please review the spec and submit your solution by Monday, 14 June 2027, 9:00 AM PT. Important notes:

- Submit a ZIP or link to a public repo with a README and short write-up of tradeoffs.
- You may use common Python libraries (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn). Calling external proprietary LLM APIs is not allowed for the evaluation.
- Please include instructions to run locally and any sample data.

Attachments: ProjectSpec.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Where to send it: reply to this thread or send to talent+submissions@redwood.ai with subject line: "Sofia Patel — Take-home Submission".

If you have any scheduling constraints for the reviewers (we'll do asynchronous scoring, but may request a 30m sync for walkthroughs), let me know.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing your work.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia — great questions. Short answers:

- Yes to numpy/pandas/scipy and typical data-science libs.
- External public data sources are fine for sample data, but please do not call third-party model APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) for the evaluation portion — we want to see your implementation.
- We prefer to keep the deadline as-is, but if something unexpected comes up let me know by EOD Thursday (June 10) and we can evaluate a short extension on a case-by-case basis.

I'll confirm reviewer availability with the hiring team and loop them in. Thanks and good luck — excited to see it.

Regards,
Laura
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jun 2027 10:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Project spec + next steps for interview (Sofia Patel)

Looping you both in on Sofia's project. Key asks here: review the submission asynchronously and score by rubric; if any of you want a 30m sync with the candidate we can schedule one after submission. Proposed plan:

- Primary reviewer: Marissa (ownership of correctness + clarity)
- Secondary reviewer: Mina (performance + tradeoffs)
- Scoring target: have all scores collected by EOD Wednesday, 16 June (gives a few buffer days if candidate requests extension).

Proposed rubric (initial):
- Correctness / completeness: 40
- Clarity of code and docs: 30
- Performance / efficiency: 20
- Thoughtful tradeoffs & write-up: 10

Please reply with any changes to ownership or weighting. I'll create a shared spreadsheet for scores and a short rubric doc.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
jonas@redwood.ai

Also would appreciate a one-pager rubric (bulleted) I can paste into reviewer notes. Do you want me to own the reviewer comments collection?
